domain_guidance.summary: This domain covers corporate activities, legal affairs, and business strategy. It focuses on understanding management resources, organizational structures, and the application of business strategy techniques to solve operational problems effectively within a professional business environment.

This domain addresses project management, service management, and system audits. It emphasizes the practical application of management techniques to ensure efficient service delivery and internal control within an organization to maintain high standards of operational quality.

This domain covers basic theory, computer systems, and technology elements. It includes the study of algorithms, hardware components, software, databases, networks, and information security implementation to ensure technical proficiency across all modern computing platforms and organizational digital infrastructure systems.

editorial.exam_day_guidance: Arrive prepared for a 120-minute session consisting of 100 questions. Manage your time effectively across the three domains to ensure you meet the required evaluation points for each field and the total score required for certification.

faq.answer_text: The exam consists of 100 questions in total, covering the three domains of Strategy, Management, and Technology. Candidates must answer these within the allotted time to demonstrate their understanding of the material.
faq.question_title: How many questions are on the exam?

faq.answer_text: To pass, you must achieve a total of 600 points out of 1000 total points, with at least 300 points out of 1000 in each individual field.

The exam duration is 120 minutes, which provides sufficient time for candidates to carefully read and respond to all questions presented across the three distinct domains of the certification assessment.

For information regarding the current certification path, please check with the Information-technology Promotion Agency, Japan (IPA) to ensure you have the most up-to-date requirements and official guidance for your examination preparation.

editorial.overview: The Japan IT Passport Certification (IPA) is a professional credential administered by the Information-technology Promotion Agency, Japan (IPA). It assesses knowledge required for IT professionals, covering three core domains: Strategy, Management, and Technology. This certification confirms a candidate's ability to understand corporate activities, project management, and technical systems, providing a standard measure of IT literacy for individuals working in various business environments. It serves as a benchmark for those entering the modern digital workforce.
editorial.preparation_strategy: Review the official syllabus to understand the breadth of topics across the three domains. Focus on mastering the sample terms and usage provided in the guide. Practice applying concepts like PDCA, break-even point calculations, and system development techniques. Utilize the official IPA exam guide to align your study with the required knowledge levels for this 100-question assessment. Consistent review of these technical and managerial concepts is required for success.
editorial.who_should_take: This certification is for individuals seeking to demonstrate IT knowledge. It is suitable for students, business professionals, and those entering the IT field who need to verify their understanding of corporate, management, and technical concepts within an organizational framework.
